intent: Create a full onboarding email sequence (7 emails), the landing page, A/B test variants, and an analytics plan for a SaaS free trial.

spec.goal: Set up the marketing and onboarding materials for a SaaS free trial: an onboarding email sequence, a landing page, A/B test variants, and an analytics plan.
spec.deliverable: A package containing a 7-email onboarding sequence (written copy), a landing page, A/B test variants, and a written analytics plan, all for a SaaS free trial.
constraints: The email sequence must contain exactly 7 emails.
All materials must target a SaaS free trial.
A/B test variants must be provided as part of the package.
The package must include an analytics plan.
Do not invent product details, brand names, pricing or audience beyond what the request states; keep content general where the request is silent.
done_criteria: The onboarding email sequence contains 7 complete emails.
A landing page for the SaaS free trial is delivered.
An analytics plan covering how the free trial performance will be measured is delivered.
spec.summary: You want a complete free trial package for a SaaS product: a 7-email onboarding sequence, a landing page, A/B test variants, and an analytics plan.
